name: VVV-CL160 (Hubble)
blurb: VVV-CL160, a globular cluster in the plane of the Milky Way, seen by Hubble.
label: vvvcl160-hubble
story: VVV-CL160 is a nearby globular cluster hidden in the plane of the Milky Way, moving across the sky unusually fast for a cluster of its kind. Astronomers suggest it may belong to the extension of the Hrid halo stream.

claims.text: VVV-CL160 is a new nearby globular cluster with extreme kinematics
It lies in the Galactic plane
It has an unusually large proper motion for a Galactic globular cluster
It may be associated with the extension of the Hrid halo stream
Hubble program 17918 targets VVV-CL160 among extremely obscured Galactic globular clusters
